content: capture attribute on <input type=file accept=image/* capture=environment> hints mobile browsers to open camera app directly instead of gallery picker; capture=user for front camera. Not a hard OS-level lock (some browsers/OEMs may still show a chooser) but works reliably on modern iOS Safari and Android Chrome. getUserMedia() + <video>/<canvas> gives full in-page live camera stream capture, stronger guarantee against gallery substitution since the app controls the capture UI end-to-end, but is more code.
